hostEntry.workspaceBinding: canonical wiki root shared with the CLI (lib/sdd-paths.js getWikiHome): $SDD_WIKI_HOME when set, else $SDD_HOME/wiki/<project-slug>; the slug derives from the git common-dir main repository directory name (worktree-safe: every worktree of one repo shares one wiki root); a per-worktree llmwiki copy is never the wiki root (ProjectRoot.v1)

env.SDD_HOME: optional override for the llmwiki distribution root (default $HOME/.sdd)

capabilitySource: observed via stdio JSON-RPC tools/list against a disposable sandbox workspace; see package.lock.json:mcpSession
